excludedClaims: No Unity scene, behavior, combat or save-converter implementation
Synthetic state availability does not prove a completed playthrough or all flag combinations
No arbitrary timed enemy/projectile/arena-wave simulation; original algorithms remain for later gameplay phases
No exhaustive animation frame, GPU shading, particle/audio playback or NPC path-time capture; phase6/23 follow
No type precision or dictionary order discarded by phase1 is reconstructed
No personal save files, account data or offline growth
diepte_seal zero-delta _process is not sampled: it can initiate a story break; its frozen _ready state and complete source are retained.

samplingPolicy.actors: Freeze every process and physics callback; include deferred creations and disabled collider updates after fixed idle flush
samplingPolicy.arrivals: Every authored arrival uses real correction in corresponding snapshot state
samplingPolicy.clock: Freeze GameState and no ordinary Farm.advance
samplingPolicy.geometry: Rows plus real tile cells/polygons, solid_cells and nested scripted/scriptless shapes, transforms, layers and disabled state
samplingPolicy.identity: Keep all declared object slots including disabled; runtime occurrence IDs never replace legacy saved keys
samplingPolicy.state: Record configured state before load and actual state after load and migrations
